nodes.label: wavetest.png – Hero Section Screenshot
nodes.description: Screenshot of the site hero/landing section. Background is a warm peach/salmon gradient sky with an illustrated tropical landscape: purple-toned mountains on the left, lush green tropical vegetation and a large banana/palm-like tree on the right. A red flat surface (wave or platform shape) spans the lower portion, acting as a visual ground plane. Centered is a blue-grey rounded video player card with a white play button. Above the video, three pill-shaped white buttons are visible: 'Instagram', 'Linkedin', and 'Nous contacter'. Top-left corner has a dark circular logo badge reading 'SUD'.
nodes.wave_shape: The red wave/platform at the bottom is a flat, wide horizontal band with a slight upward curve or plateau shape — no complex sinusoidal wave visible. It fills the lower ~20% of the viewport width edge-to-edge.
nodes.wave_color: Solid red (#e0 range), no gradient. Provides strong contrast against the illustrated green foliage.
nodes.overflow_issues: No visible overflow clipping issues; the red band and tropical illustration appear to render within viewport bounds without horizontal scroll artifacts.
nodes.positioning: Red band is bottom-aligned, behind the video card. The video card sits centered on top of the red band. Social link buttons float above, vertically centered in the upper half.
nodes.wave_background_interaction: The red wave/band creates a stage-like platform under the video player, separating the illustrated tropical scene from the video content. The green foliage from the illustration overlaps the sides of the red band, giving a layered depth effect.
